# Perfuncted v1.3.1

- **KDE Wayland windows:** Added KWin-native active-window details, compositor cursor-position queries, keep-above/keep-below, fullscreen, and supported titlebar shading.
- **Virtual desktops:** Added `pf desktop list` and `pf desktop switch`, plus `pf window set-desktop` to assign an existing window to a compositor desktop.
- **Native tiling:** Added `pf window tile` and `pf window float` for KWin custom tiling, with compositor state verification rather than geometry-only emulation.
- **Pointer automation:** Added `pf input move-relative` using verified coordinate spaces and compositor cursor read-back. Wayland input still requires an authorized backend; unsupported or unverified operations fail rather than claiming success.
- **Flatpak and CI:** Improved Flatpak Go SDK patch-version compatibility, fixed bundle permissions, and made real KDE Wayland desktop tests mandatory for stable release builds.

KWin window and desktop behavior was verified in an isolated KDE Wayland session. Input authorization and capabilities vary by compositor and desktop configuration; full KDE pointer/keyboard injection is not universally verified.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nskaggs/perfuncted/compare/v1.3.0...v1.3.1
